payload.title: Restore Python 3.12 JSON file-model compatibility
payload.summary: The declared Python >=3.12 distribution fails a JsonObjectFile constructor on installed CPython 3.12.13. Current development verification uses Python 3.14; compatibility remains unresolved.
evidence: docs/implementation_ledger.md (unchanged-main JsonObjectFile reproduction and prior 54 Python 3.12 test failures)
payload.benefit: Restore trustworthy declared-version compatibility and prevent local worker/environment confusion.
payload.uncertainty: The affected model family, minimal correction, and supported interpreter test matrix require investigation. This proposal provides no implementation or execution authority.
dependencies: B-0009: pressure only; the current worker remains validated on Python 3.14.
